summary.text: Fran Nutter-Upham is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 8, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A psychotherapist and art therapist from Nashua, she served in the state House from 2018 until losing re-election in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Fran Nutter-Upham lives in Nashua and graduated from Merrimack High School.

She earned a bachelor's degree in art history from the University of New Hampshire and a master's in expressive therapies and art history from Lesley University, and her career experience includes working as a psychotherapist and art therapist.
Nutter-Upham was first elected to the New Hampshire House of Representatives in 2018, winning a seat in Hillsborough 33.
She was assigned to the Health, Human Services and Elderly Affairs Committee in the 2019-2020, 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
She represented Hillsborough 8 after redistricting and left office on December 4, 2024, after losing the November 2024 general election to two incumbent Democrats and Republican Kevin Scully.
